contextual_decision: The partially observable and adversarial FL environment requires relevant detection and monitoring evidence to be available early enough to support review before aggregation
engineering_representation: Security-relevant detection and monitoring evidence shall be available before aggregation where supported by the documented detection mechanism and shall remain available for operational review
anchoring_requirement: Detection evidence must be available before aggregation under the documented operating conditions
scope_decision: Retain the existing training structure while using the documented pre-aggregation monitoring location
placement_constraint: Place detection and monitoring before aggregation where the evidence can still support review
process_specific_activity_or_control_poi: Pre-aggregation detection and monitoring during relevant training rounds
instantiated_lifecycle_artefact: Documented pre-aggregation detection and monitoring mechanism
responsible_role: Operations and Security Team / Server Coordinator
evidence_link: Original Federated Learning architecture, detection, and monitoring documentation
notes: Illustrative reconstruction; does not imply prospective CRISP-TAI execution

contextual_decision: Detection evidence requires explicit interpretation before it can justify an engineering or operational response
engineering_representation: Detection or anomaly evidence shall be interpreted against the applicable operating conditions before any resulting engineering adjustment or operational response is represented
anchoring_requirement: Operational review must remain connected to the detection evidence that triggered it
scope_decision: Retain the documented review and response mechanisms while preserving the distinction between evidence and decision
placement_constraint: Review relevant detection evidence before any resulting operational response is enacted
process_specific_activity_or_control_poi: Detection-evidence review and response decision point
instantiated_lifecycle_artefact: Documented alert or anomaly interpretation and technical response or mitigation mechanism
evidence_link: Original Federated Learning detection, review, and response documentation
notes: FR.3 represents a required adjustment before enactment; a detection signal is not an automatic decision

contextual_decision: Detection, monitoring, and review capabilities must remain available across successive training rounds while their supporting conditions remain valid
engineering_representation: Relevant detection, monitoring, and review obligations shall remain active across successive training rounds and shall be reconsidered when their supporting technical or contextual conditions materially change
anchoring_requirement: Monitoring and review must persist across successive training rounds
scope_decision: Retain and adapt the documented repeated-round monitoring mechanism where relevant system conditions change
placement_constraint: Maintain detection, monitoring, and review across continued training rounds
instantiated_lifecycle_artefact: Continued detection, monitoring, and review across successive training rounds
responsible_role: Server / Coordinator; Operations and Security Team
evidence_link: Original Federated Learning repeated-round monitoring documentation
notes: Illustrative reconstruction of continuity; relevant assumptions and anchoring conditions require review after material system change
